import sys

def solve(s):
    # Replace first occurrence of "at" starting from index 1 with "@"
    pos = s.find("at", 1)
    if pos != -1:
        s = s[:pos] + "@" + s[pos+2:]
    
    # Replace all occurrences of "dot" starting from index 1, except at the end
    pos = s.find("dot", 1)
    while pos != -1 and len(s) != pos + 3:
        s = s[:pos] + "." + s[pos+3:]
        pos = s.find("dot", 1)
    
    return s

def main():
    email = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    result = solve(email)
    sys.stdout.write(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
